NONE: › an evergreen plant (= one that never loses its leaves) with thick, pointed leaves
› a type of plant with thick pointed leaves, or the thick liquid found in the leaves that is used to treat damaged skin
蘆薈；蘆薈汁（可用來治療受損皮膚）
› in the air or in a higher position

example: We held our glasses aloft.
我們高舉酒杯。

NONE: 單獨（的），獨自（的）；孤獨的（地），無伴的（地）

example: He likes being alone in the house.
他喜歡自己一個人呆在家裡。
She decided to climb the mountain alone.
她決定獨自去爬那座山。
Do you like living alone?
你喜歡獨居嗎？
At last, we're alone together (= there are just the two of us here).
我們終於可以享受二人世界了。
The Swedes are not alone in finding their language under pressure from the spread of English.
感受到自己國家的母語面臨著英語廣泛使用壓力的不僅僅是瑞典人。
I don't like the man and I'm not alone in that (= other people agree).
我不喜歡那個人，而且並不是我一個人這樣覺得。
She alone needs to decide what to do (= no one else can do it for her).
她必須自己決定做甚麼。
These facts alone (= even if nothing else is considered) show that he's not to be trusted.
單憑這些事實就可以看出他這個人不可信。
He won't get the job through charm alone (= he will need something else).
單靠個人魅力他是不會得到這份工作的。
The airfare alone would use up all my money, never mind the hotel bills.
光買飛機票就會讓我分文不剩，更別說住旅館了。
Price alone is not a reliable indicator of quality.
價格本身並不能準確反映品質。

NONE: A2 from one part of a road, river, etc. to another
B1 in a line next to something long
沿著…的邊緣；沿著…成一行
B2 at a particular place on a road, river, etc.
B2 in addition to someone or something else

example: a romantic walk along the beach/river
沿著海灘／河邊的浪漫散步
a row of houses along the river
沿河修建的一排房子
Cars were parked all along the road.
沿路停滿了汽車。
Somewhere along this road there's a garage.
順著這條路走，修車廠就在路邊。
We were just walking along, chatting.
我們就這麼一邊往前走一邊聊。
Why don't you take him along with you when you go?
你去的時候，為甚麼不讓他也跟著一起去呢？
I'll bring some food along and we can have a picnic.
我會帶些吃的，這樣我們就可以野餐了。
California, along with Florida and Hawaii, is among the most popular US tourist destinations.
除了佛羅裡達和夏威夷之外，加利福尼亞也是人們最常光顧的美國旅遊勝地。
I was thinking of doing a meal along the lines of that dinner I did for Annie and Dave.
我想做一頓類似那次給安妮和戴夫做的飯菜。
They're campaigning for the electoral system to be reformed along the lines of (= so that it becomes similar to) the one in Germany.
他們在爭取仿照德國的選舉制度而對自己進行改造。
My sister works in publishing, and I’m hoping to do something along the same lines.
我姐姐在出版業工業，我希望做類似的工作。

NONE: › during the time that something is happening or that you are doing something
在這個過程中；在這期間

example: I've been in this job for 30 years, and I've picked up a good deal of expertise along the way.
我做這份工作已經30年了，在此期間我掌握了大量專業技術。

NONE: C1 next to, or together with

example: The new pill will be used alongside existing medicines.
這種新藥將配合現有藥物一起服用。
Most of the staff refused to work alongside the new team.
大多數職員拒絕和這個新團隊一起工作。
The UK fought alongside France, Turkey, and Sardinia during the Crimean War.
在克裡米亞戰爭中，英國和法國、土耳其以及撒丁尼亞王國並肩作戰。

NONE: › not friendly or willing to take part in things
› not interested or involved, usually because you do not approve of what is happening
（通常因為對所發生的事情不贊同而）漠不關心的，無動於衷的，不參與的

example: She seemed rather aloof when in fact she was just shy.
她看似孤傲不群，可實際上只是靦腆。
Whatever is happening in the office, she always remains aloof.
不管辦公室發生了甚麼事，她都一概不聞不問。
She kept herself aloof from her husband's business.
她對丈夫的事情漠不關心。

NONE: › loss of hair, especially from the head, that either happens naturally or is caused by disease
毛髮脫落；變禿；（尤指）脫髮
B1 in a voice loud enough to be heard

example: He read her letter aloud to the rest of the family.
他把她的信大聲讀給家人聽。
People are starting to wonder aloud (= question publicly) whether the economic reforms have gone too far.
人們開始公開質疑經濟改革是否矯枉過正了。
